title: Network Event KPIs
description: Distinct processed events and current operational state from read-only KPI views.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Total events"
FROM kpi_event_facts AS event
WHERE event_timestamp >= to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0) AND event_timestamp < to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0)
  AND (${device_id:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR device_id::text = ${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND (${device:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR device_name = ${device:sqlstring})
  AND (${severity:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR severity = ${severity:sqlstring})
  AND (${category:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR category = ${category:sqlstring})
  AND (${incident:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM kpi_incident_events AS link
      WHERE link.event_id = event.event_id AND link.incident_id = ${incident:sqlstring}
  ))

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'critical') AS critical,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'high') AS high
FROM kpi_event_facts AS event
WHERE event_timestamp >= to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0) AND event_timestamp < to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0)
  AND (${device_id:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR device_id::text = ${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND (${device:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR device_name = ${device:sqlstring})
  AND (${severity:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR severity = ${severity:sqlstring})
  AND (${category:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR category = ${category:sqlstring})
  AND (${incident:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM kpi_incident_events AS link
      WHERE link.event_id = event.event_id AND link.incident_id = ${incident:sqlstring}
  ))

SELECT date_trunc(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} <= 259200000 THEN 'hour' ELSE 'day' END, event_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time, count(*) AS events
FROM kpi_event_facts AS event
WHERE event_timestamp >= to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0) AND event_timestamp < to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0)
  AND (${device_id:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR device_id::text = ${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND (${device:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR device_name = ${device:sqlstring})
  AND (${severity:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR severity = ${severity:sqlstring})
  AND (${category:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR category = ${category:sqlstring})
  AND (${incident:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM kpi_incident_events AS link
      WHERE link.event_id = event.event_id AND link.incident_id = ${incident:sqlstring}
  ))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} <= 259200000 THEN 'hour' ELSE 'day' END, ingested_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time, count(*) AS events
FROM kpi_event_facts AS event
WHERE ingested_at >= to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0) AND ingested_at < to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0)
  AND (${device_id:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR device_id::text = ${device_id:sqlstring})

  AND (${severity:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR severity = ${severity:sqlstring})
  AND (${category:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR category = ${category:sqlstring})
  AND (${incident:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM kpi_incident_events AS link
      WHERE link.event_id = event.event_id AND link.incident_id = ${incident:sqlstring}
  ))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT severity, count(*) AS events
FROM kpi_event_facts AS event
WHERE event_timestamp >= to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0) AND event_timestamp < to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0)
  AND (${device_id:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR device_id::text = ${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND (${device:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR device_name = ${device:sqlstring})
  AND (${severity:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR severity = ${severity:sqlstring})

      WHERE link.event_id = event.event_id AND link.incident_id = ${incident:sqlstring}

SELECT category, count(*) AS events
FROM kpi_event_facts AS event
WHERE event_timestamp >= to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0) AND event_timestamp < to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0)
  AND (${device_id:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR device_id::text = ${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND (${device:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR device_name = ${device:sqlstring})
  AND (${severity:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR severity = ${severity:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(${__to} - ${__from}, 0) AS events_per_second
FROM kpi_event_facts AS event
WHERE ingested_at >= to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0) AND ingested_at < to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0)
  AND (${device_id:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR device_id::text = ${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND (${device:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR device_name = ${device:sqlstring})
  AND (${severity:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR severity = ${severity:sqlstring})

  AND (${incident:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM kpi_incident_events AS link
      WHERE link.event_id = event.event_id AND link.incident_id = ${incident:sqlstring}

panels.title: Device status
panels.description: Current registry status for the selected device ID and name.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT status, count(*) AS devices FROM kpi_device_facts
WHERE (${device_id:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR device_id::text = ${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND (${device:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR lower(name) = lower(${device:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

panels.title: Incident totals and resolution
panels.description: Current incident state and latest resolutions in the selected window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT *, status = 'resolved' AND status_changed_at >= to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0)
    AND status_changed_at < to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0) AS resolved_in_range
  FROM kpi_incident_facts AS alert WHERE first_seen < to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0)
    AND (${severity:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR severity = ${severity:sqlstring})
    AND (${incident:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR incident_id = ${incident:sqlstring})
    AND (${category:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR event_types ?| (
      CASE ${category:sqlstring}
        WHEN 'interface' THEN ARRAY['link_up', 'link_down', 'port_flap']
        WHEN 'routing' THEN ARRAY['routing_neighbor_down', 'routing_neighbor_up', 'routing_neighbor_state_change']
        WHEN 'authentication' THEN ARRAY['login_failure']
        WHEN 'firewall' THEN ARRAY['acl_deny']
        WHEN 'configuration' THEN ARRAY['configuration_change']
        WHEN 'security' THEN ARRAY['port_security']
        ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
      END
    ))
    AND (
      (${device_id:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' AND (
        ${device:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR alert.device_name = ${device:sqlstring}
      ))
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM kpi_incident_events AS link
        JOIN kpi_event_facts AS event USING (event_id)
        WHERE link.incident_id = alert.incident_id
          AND (${device_id:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR event.device_id::text = ${device_id:sqlstring})
          AND (${device:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR event.device_name = ${device:sqlstring})
      )
    )
)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'resolved') AS active,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved_in_range) AS resolved,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'critical' AND (status <> 'resolved' OR resolved_in_range)) AS critical,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'high' AND (status <> 'resolved' OR resolved_in_range)) AS high,
  avg(extract(epoch FROM status_changed_at - first_seen))
    FILTER (WHERE resolved_in_range AND status_changed_at >= first_seen) AS mean_resolution_seconds
FROM selected
